meta.purpose: Margin math (margin != markup), the conversion matrix, and target margins by service. This is the #1 underpricing-error guardrail.
meta.source: compass_artifact C; Service Pricing Cost Calculation (margin-vs-markup, conversion matrix). Restores formulas missing from the source doc render.

formulas.cost: direct labor (hrs x loaded cost/hr) + allocated overhead + pass-through (licenses, stock, cloud, outsourced) + contingency
formulas.price_from_margin: Price = Cost / (1 - Margin%)   <-- DEFAULT QUOTING ENGINE

critical_warning.rule: Markup and margin are NOT the same. Markup% > Margin% always, for the same transaction.
critical_warning.worked: Cost $70, sell $100 -> profit $30. Markup = 30/70 = 42.9%. Margin = 30/100 = 30.0%. Same dollars, different %.
critical_warning.fatal_error: Targeting 30% margin but applying 30% MARKUP. $100 cost x 1.30 = $130 -> actual margin = 30/130 = 23% (not 30%). To get 30% margin: Price = 100/0.70 = $142.86 (= 42.9% markup).

canonical_defaults.contingency: 15-25% of cost-to-date BEFORE applying margin (use 20% default)
canonical_defaults.note: Egypt-cost delivery sold at GLOBAL price realizes effective gross margin far above these (local labor 5-10x cheaper). Treat surplus as competitive discount OR retained profit — but net it against tax friction first (egypt_tax_2026.json).

benchmark_net_margins_2025.specialization: Agencies that REDUCED services averaged 30% net; those that expanded averaged 10%. Average project margin ~35%.

diagnostics.net_under_10pct: pricing/utilization/overhead problem -> raise prices or cut waste
diagnostics.utilization_over_85pct: underpriced or understaffed -> raise rates or hire
diagnostics.project_margin_under_30pct: re-scope, re-price, or drop the service line
diagnostics.service_over_30pct_net: scale it — that's your specialist edge
